notes:
Summary / context: Mid-market SaaS (product analytics) building in-app support assistant + semantic search + reranking for product docs. CTO James Lee: "We need a 3x reduction in inference costs to justify Dedicated commitment." Very cost sensitive.

Requirements / targets (from calls): p95 latency for chat fallback <200ms preferred for UI, embeddings throughput ~80-120 qps for nightly batch enrichment, rerank path needs sub-100ms p50 on Dedicated when batched. Tolerance for INT8 / 4-bit quantization if QA pass on sample prompts. Prefix/KV caching for chat sessions is a must (many repeat queries).

POC & success metrics: 1) cost per active user inference <= target in forecast model, 2) embedding quality delta <= 1% vs baseline, 3) sustained throughput targets with <1% error rate.

Workshop notes (planned): Redwood to run cost-optimization workshop covering: recommended batching windows and target batch size ranges; where to apply prefix/KV caching vs TTL; suggested quantization profiles per model family and expected latency/cost tradeoffs; unit economics workbook (tokens -> $ per 1k users); recommended routing policy for hosted->dedicated fallback. SE Priya will prepare sample scripts and synthetic load harness.

Procurement / legal: waiting on final data residency confirmation (EU vs US keys), licensing language for optimized/quantized runtime, and committed capacity terms (burst vs reserved).

Quotes / call snippets: "If we can hit that cost curve, we go Dedicated and move to committed plan Q2." — VP Product (Hannah Ortiz).

Next actions: run workshop 2026-03-16, deliver workshop slide deck + workbook, start phase A baseline on Hosted API week of 2026-03-23, then phase B Dedicated test 2-week window. Follow-up pricing revision after workshop.
